description: Public-facing UX improvements: PDF/image preview + WhatsApp share on paper detail (items 4, 12), search autocomplete (item 10), bulk upload post-success actions + smart defaults (items 3, 13). These are independent of FEAT-002 (admin) and FEAT-004 (email subscription). FEAT-001 should complete first for ThemeToggle, but these items don't depend on it directly.
steps: Item 10 — Update GET /api/courses to accept q param: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/app/api/courses/route.ts. Change the GET function signature from `export async function GET()` to `export async function GET(req: NextRequest)`. NextRequest is already imported for POST. If q = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('q')?.trim() is truthy, add .or(`code.ilike.%${q}%,name.ilike.%${q}%`) to the query. Otherwise return all courses (existing behavior unchanged).

Item 10 — Search autocomplete in SearchBar: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/components/SearchBar.tsx. Add import for CoursesRow from @/types/database and useRef (already imported via React). Add state: suggestions (CoursesRow[]), showDropdown (boolean). Add wrapperRef = useRef(null). Add click-outside useEffect that listens for mousedown on document and closes dropdown when click is outside wrapperRef. Add fetchSuggestions async function: if term.length < 2, clear suggestions and hide dropdown; else fetch /api/courses?q=${encodeURIComponent(term)}, set suggestions to first 6 results, show dropdown if results exist. Item 4 — CSP frame-src update: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/next.config.mjs. Find the frame-src directive string 'frame-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com' and change it to 'frame-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://*.supabase.co'. This allows the signed Supabase Storage URL to load in the iframe.

Items 3 + 13 — UploadForm bulk upload UX and smart defaults: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/components/UploadForm.tsx. (A) Smart defaults on mount: add useEffect that runs once on mount. If editPaper prop is falsy, read localStorage.getItem('pq:lastCourseId'), 'pq:lastLevel', 'pq:lastSemester' and call setCourseId/setLevel/setSemester if the values exist. Dependency array: [editPaper] (or [] with editPaper.id check). (B) On success, before resetting the form: call localStorage.setItem for all three keys, and store { courseId, level, semester } in a lastUpload state variable. (C) Post-success buttons: below the existing success message div (and only when formState === 'success'), add a flex div with two buttons: (1) 'Upload another' button (type='button') that restores courseId/level/semester from lastUpload state and sets formState to 'idle'; (2) an <a href='/admin/papers'> styled as a button 'Go to papers'. (D) 'Save as draft and upload another' variant: add a boolean ref isDraftAndContinueRef = useRef(false). Add a second submit button below the main 'Upload paper' button: <button type='button' disabled={isSubmitting || !file} onClick={() => { isDraftAndContinueRef.current = true; formRef.current?.requestSubmit() }}...>'Save as draft + upload another'</button>. In handleSubmit, after success: if isDraftAndContinueRef.current is true, instead of full reset — clear only title and file (keep courseId/level/semester), set formState to 'idle', and reset isDraftAndContinueRef.current to false. Add a formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null) and attach ref={formRef} to the <form>.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/courses?q=cs returns courses whose code or name contains 'cs'
SearchBar shows a dropdown with course suggestions when 2+ characters are typed
Dropdown dismisses on Escape key or click outside
Clicking a suggestion sets the search value and closes the dropdown
Paper detail page shows an iframe for PDF files and an img for jpg/png files
Preview uses a signed URL; DownloadButton still points to /api/papers/[id]/download
Paper detail page has a green WhatsApp share button
WhatsApp URL includes the paper title and full paper URL
After successful upload, 'Upload another' and 'Go to papers' buttons appear
On UploadForm mount (non-edit mode), courseId/level/semester are pre-filled from localStorage if available
npm run build exits 0 with zero errors
findings: All 5 steps implemented and verified. GET /api/courses now accepts ?q= for course code/name filtering. SearchBar gained autocomplete dropdown with keyboard (Escape) and click-outside dismissal. Paper detail page shows a signed-URL iframe (PDF) or img (image) preview plus a green WhatsApp share button. CSP frame-src extended to https://*.supabase.co. UploadForm gained: localStorage smart defaults on mount, lastUpload state for post-success restore, 'Upload another'/'Go to papers' buttons after success, and 'Save as draft + upload another' second submit button. Build: exit 0. Lint: 0 warnings/errors.
